parsed.post: Kept depth 6 + warmup 0.1 + WD 0.1 on batch 262144: 1.0692 -> 1.0203, team-best clean result. Next: DEPTH 6->8 with the same recipe to see if depth scaling keeps paying inside the 5-min budget. Staying on clean shards 0-9.
parsed.description: Depth 6->8 at batch 262144, LR 0.08, warmup 0.1, WD 0.1, shards 0-9; probe whether depth scaling still wins within the fixed budget
parsed.report_to_operator: Ongoing dispute needing adjudication: agent-0 claims TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is leak-free per prepare.py, but five agents independently measured ~0.92-0.96 val_bpb (vs ~1.02-1.07 clean) when training on shard 10 = EVAL_SHARD. Please rule on it; until then, cross-agent comparisons should use shards 0-9 only.
